title: CroCoDeEL: accurate control-free detection of cross-sample contamination in metagenomic data
task: Control-free detection of cross-sample contamination in metagenomic data using linear modeling and supervised learning
key_results: CroCoDeEL detects contamination at <0.1% rates; identifies contamination sources without negative controls; applied to existing studies reveals previously undetected contamination
comments: Addresses practical limitation of existing methods requiring negative controls; validates on public datasets.

model_io.model: CroCoDeEL: linear modeling + pre-trained supervised classifier
inputs: species abundance profiles from metagenomic sequencing

hypotheses.hypothesis: Cross-sample contamination creates detectable patterns in species abundance profiles
hypotheses.result: CroCoDeEL detected contaminated samples and identified sources even at <0.1% contamination rates with sufficient sequencing depth

title: sc-ChromAging: A Single-Cell Chromatin Accessibility-based Clock Decodes Cell-Type-Specific Epigenetic Aging Trajectories
task: Develop chromatin accessibility-based aging clock using single-cell ATAC-seq to decode cell-type-specific epigenetic aging
key_results: sc-ChromAging developed on 401 Chinese individuals; CD4+ naive T cells identified as most accurate age predictors; linked immune aging to inflammation/infection/tumor pathways; connected chromatin changes to plasma metabolites
comments: Novel single-cell approach to aging clocks; pathway linkage to plasma metabolites adds biological relevance.

model_io.model: sc-ChromAging: chromatin accessibility-based aging clock

hypotheses.hypothesis: CD4+ naive T cells provide the most accurate epigenetic age predictions
hypotheses.result: sc-ChromAging identified CD4+ naive T cells as superior age predictors among cell types tested

title: CT-TADB predicts TAD boundaries without Hi-C by integrating DNA sequences and epigenomic features
task: Predict TAD boundaries from DNA sequence and epigenomic features without Hi-C data using CNN-Transformer
key_results: AUC 0.932-0.950 on six human cell lines; CTCF identified as dominant boundary factor; cross-species generalization to mouse (AUC >0.80); identified PITX2-associated TAD linked to cardiac arrhythmia
comments: Hybrid architecture elegantly combines sequence and epigenomic signals; cross-cell-type transfer validates model robustness.

model_io.model: CT-TADB: hybrid CNN-Transformer framework

hypotheses.hypothesis: TAD boundaries are predictable from DNA sequence and epigenomic features without Hi-C
hypotheses.result: CT-TADB achieved AUC 0.932-0.950; maintained performance on cross-cell-type and cross-species transfer

hypotheses.hypothesis: CTCF is the dominant TAD boundary-associated factor
hypotheses.result: Feature attribution analysis identified CTCF as dominant factor with supporting active chromatin marks

title: MicroRNA profiles in colostrum and transition milk of non-dairy goats fed with or without resveratrol
task: Profile microRNAs in goat colostrum and transition milk with/without resveratrol supplementation
key_results: 406 known microRNAs identified from 30 milk samples; let-7c-5p most abundant (10.48%), followed by let-7a-5p (9.18%) and let-7f-5p (8.19%); microRNA profiles clustered by lactation stage independent of diet
comments: Resource paper providing descriptive characterization; limited mechanistic insight into resveratrol effects on milk microRNA composition.

model_io.model: microRNA profiling via small extracellular vesicle sequencing

hypotheses.hypothesis: Resveratrol supplementation alters milk microRNA composition
hypotheses.result: MicroRNA profiles clustered by lactation stage (0d vs 7d) regardless of resveratrol supplementation; effect not evident

title: Advanced computer-aided diagnosis for age-related macular degeneration: integrating segmentation and feature extraction for precise diagnosis
task: Computer-aided diagnosis for AMD detection and classification using deep learning and ensemble methods
key_results: SegNet-MobileNet segmentation; ensemble methods (CatBoost, XGBoost, Extra Trees) achieved >97% accuracy on 864 retinal images; SHAP explainability provided feature importance

model_io.model: SegNet-MobileNet + Ensemble classifiers (CatBoost/XGBoost/Extra Trees)

title: Explainable artificial intelligence with pyramid vision transformer model for multi-class malignant cell classification on cytology slides
task: Explainable multi-class malignant cell classification from cytology slides using pyramid vision transformer and temporal RNN
key_results: HTDL-MCCCS model: 98.16% accuracy (SIPaKMeD), 96.42% accuracy (Herlev); pyramid vision transformer for robust feature learning; Grad-CAM interpretability; reduces inter/intra-operator variability

title: Graph neural networks can predict ketosynthase substrate specificity
task: Predict ketosynthase substrate specificity and proofreading using GNNs on AlphaFold structures
key_results: 81-92% AUC distinguishing β-carbon reduction states; 79% AUC predicting α-methylation state; GNN-guided mutations improved non-native substrate acceptance

title: A statistically rigorous multi-scale texture analysis framework for 3D spheroid characterization: temporal autocorrelation correction and molecular validation

comments: Sophisticated statistical framework addressing temporal dependence; external RNA-seq validation strengthens biological relevance.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Ensemble texture features capture biological differences between cell lines concordant with molecular profiles

hypotheses.hypothesis: Temporal autocorrelation must be corrected for valid statistical inference in spheroid time-series
